## Map Krishna's model here
Add any **Chat Model** node (Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, Bedrock, or another supported provider) and connect its **Model** output to the **Krishna LLM** node below. Credentials remain in n8n. Then publish this workflow and choose **n8n Workflow Nodes** in Ekvaar Settings.
